主要内容: On February 2, 2017, The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2016. The release also includes the Company's estimates related to its fiscal 2017 third quarter and full year net sales and diluted net earnings per common share. On February 1, 2017, the Company declared a quarterly dividend in the amount of $0.34 per share on the Company's Class A and Class B Common Stock. The dividend is payable in cash on March 15, 2017 to stockholders of record at the close of business on February 28, 2017.
